en.t: There is no need to say any more!
After saying this, she began to cry.

units.source_text: 夫人回头望望这邸宅，想起了今后无缘再见，便凝视那些并不足观的“树梢”，

en.t: The lady looked back at the mansion, thinking that she would never have the chance to see it again, and fixed her gaze on those unremarkable treetops,

units.source_text: 屡屡“回头”，“直到望不见”了才罢。

en.t: turning back again and again, and only stopped when it could no longer be seen.
It was not that she was attached to her lord's house,

units.source_text: 只为这是多年以来惯住之处，安得不伤离惜别呢？

en.t: but because this was the place where she had lived for many years; how could she not grieve and feel the sorrow of parting?
